assigned_sense.dictionary_meaning: A genitive or attributive particle linking one noun to another, marking possession, relation, or modification.
assigned_sense.nuance: Here it links a noun to the head noun that follows, without carrying independent lexical content.
assigned_sense.register: Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

cases.full_context: 無名，天地之始，有名，萬物之母。
